lessons.text: Camera scale about center pushes top-placed words off frame at peak push — moved word block lower (y150) to survive 1.16x scale.
Kinetic words overlapped the tall carrier until the carrier was dropped to y640 and words narrowed to a 1200px centered column.
Payoff must land ON the drop: kept landscape cut until 14.05 and bloomed the vertical share card 14.3-14.75 with a carrier size jump.
Opening composer read too small (~45% width) — grew carrier widths to 1060-1220 so subject fills 55-65% of frame.
Camera scale about center pushed top words off frame at peak push — fixed by narrowing words to 1200px column, lowering to y200/300, and steering camera focus cy to 480 during payoff.
Timeline-to-player cross-reveal caused double-exposure frames — fixed by making the old layer leave (13.0-13.4) before the new one enters (13.4-14.2) instead of overlapping at half opacity.
Payoff had no velocity on the drop because the bloom ended exactly at the drop — extended bloom 13.0-15.0 so the carrier is still growing through 14.4, and moved the word change onto the drop.
Player-to-share swap read as a hard cut — staggered word change to 17.4 and made the morph sequential (out 16.8-17.1, in 17.1+) to spread pixel change.
